svg.title: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate: a worker reports real task progress and preserves failures
svg.text: a freshly generated project passes its own quality gate
Scenario: a worker reports real task progress and preserves failures

g.text: Given a task emits real output before failing
GitLab shows the disposable Taskfile.yml: its probe task prints "native task output", then exits with code 7.
Then the CI job log shows the worker's real task output and keeps the job failed
The real CI job runs that task through the test suite's worker, the helper that streams a task's output back while the
task runs. The log shows "native task output", then Task's own "exit status 7".
The worker reports "Worker task exit code: 201", the code Task gives a failed command, and GitLab marks the job Failed:

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 2 steps · 2 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
